title: n8n-MCP incorrect authorization exposes default-scope workflow version backups in multi-tenant HTTP mode (CVE-2026-55608)
summary: n8n-mcp before 2.57.4, in multi-tenant HTTP mode (ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT=true), lets an authenticated tenant reach the server's local default-scope workflow_versions backups under certain conditions instead of being confined to its own tenant scope — reading or deleting backups left from a prior single-tenant deployment or migration period, which may contain sensitive workflow logic and node configuration. Fixed in 2.57.4.
